title: AiProxy configuration
description: Settings bound to AiProxyOptions. See README.md for the full narrative documentation.

ListenUrl.description: Address the proxy listens on. Keep it on loopback unless you know what you are exposing.

ProxyApiKey.description: Optional bearer key clients must present. Empty disables the check. Prefer supplying this via the ProxyApiKey environment variable rather than storing it here.

ClientId.description: GitHub OAuth app client id used for the device flow.

UpstreamBaseUrl.description: Fallback API base URL. The real one is normally returned by the Copilot token exchange and differs by plan.

Ollama.description: Ollama-shaped routes under /api, used by VS Code's built-in Ollama provider.

ModelPriorityHighToLow.description: Your models ranked most powerful (and usually most expensive) first. Shared by every feature that chooses between models: the gearbox lays its automatic gears out along it (gear 1 the cheapest), and fallback steps down it instead of escalating onto a pricier model. Entries are matched tolerantly: a short label ("Opus"), a full model id ("claude-opus-5"), or a partial one ("sonnet-4.5") all work; labels survive version bumps. Models left out simply carry no ranking. Empty keeps the previous behavior.

Caveman.description: LLM-driven natural-language compression of prompt content (opt-in).

Provider.description: Name of a connected provider whose credentials call the compression model, e.g. "ollama".

Model.description: Model id used for the transform. Should be cheap/local so compression does not cost more than it saves.

CompressRequests.description: Compress matching prompt content on the way upstream.

DecompressResponses.description: Expand caveman text in the assistant response. Only useful when the upstream is instructed to answer in caveman form.

MinCharacters.description: Skip content shorter than this; short content rarely justifies an extra round-trip.

Fallback.description: Retries a request against another model when the upstream returns a retryable status (opt-in).

Mode.description: Auto derives alternatives from the connected models (no model ids to maintain). Chains only fails over for models listed in Chains.

MaxCandidates.description: Maximum number of alternatives tried in Auto mode, not counting the primary attempt.

Exclude.description: Models Auto must never fail over onto, typically the expensive ones.

RetryStatusCodes.description: Upstream statuses that trigger a fallback. Transport failures always do. Any other status is returned to the client unchanged.

Chains.description: Optional explicit overrides. A chain wins over Auto for its first (requested) model.

Models.description: Models in priority order. The first is the model clients request; the rest are the alternatives.

Gearbox.description: Manual model shifter: re-routes every request onto the model of the engaged gear (opt-in).

Selected.description: Gear engaged at startup. "N" means Neutral: the client's own model choice is honored.

MaxAutoGears.description: How many gears to build from the connected models when Gears is left empty.

Gears.description: Gears in display order. Leave empty to have the shifter built automatically from the connected models.

Position.description: Short position label on the shifter, e.g. "1" or "R". "N" is reserved for Neutral.

Label.description: Optional human-friendly gear name. Falls back to the model id in the UI.

Model.description: Model engaged by this gear. Empty makes the gear a pass-through, like Neutral.

PixelPress.description: Renders bulky prompt text into a PNG so vision models pay image tokens instead of text tokens. Lossy, so off by default.

MinCharacters.description: Only render text blocks at least this long; images have a fixed token floor.

FontSize.description: Font size in pixels. Smaller is denser but harder for the model to read.

MaxColumns.description: Hard-wrap width in monospace characters per line.

IncludeHint.description: Prepend a short instruction telling the model the image contains rendered text.

ReasoningEffort.description: Publishes reasoning models once per thinking effort as "<model>:<level>" ids, because clients like VS Code's Ollama provider offer no effort control. The levels come from the upstream model catalog, and the suffix is translated back into reasoning_effort.

Levels.description: Optional filter over the levels each model advertises, so the picker is not flooded. Intersected with what the model actually accepts, so a missing level is skipped rather than sent. Empty publishes them all. Filters publishing only: a level named directly is still honoured.

OpenAiProviders.description: OpenAI-compatible upstreams. Each entry becomes a provider you can connect with 'AiProxy connect <name>'.

Name.description: Provider id used on the CLI and for stored state, e.g. "openai" or "openrouter".

BaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL including any version segment, e.g. "https://api.openai.com/v1".

ApiKey.description: Optional plaintext key for non-interactive setups. Prefer 'AiProxy connect <name>', which stores it encrypted.

Models.description: Optional default allow-list, used as the pre-filled selection during connect.
